conclusions: Explicit axes preserve the observed CJK family; they do not reset it.
In admitted C8 profiles, 801c/2 selects HGHT, /3 selects HGKT and /4 selects HGSS, overriding the previous style family.
A following 8002 resets the family to its own style, including an identical style word.
The C8 override applies to Han, fullwidth Latin, space and ampersand in the admitted placement classes. Ordinary a0 Latin and low 006c retain their separate rules.
HN-B mode 2 admits 801c/4 and selects HGSS until a following 8002 resets it. No new HN-B mode-0 controls are admitted.
